title: CAPM time-series regression: Jensen alpha and beta
deliverables: per asset [N]: alpha, beta, t-stats, R2
frame: DIKETAHUI: asset returns [T x N], market returns [T], risk-free [T] (decimal or percent). DITANYAKAN: alpha (per period and annualised), beta, OLS t-stats, R2 per asset. RUMUS: Core 1: R_i-RF=a+b(Rm-RF)+e; s2=SSR/(n-2); toolkit ols(y, X, add_const=True). JAWAB: 1) units: percent /100. 2) excess returns. 3) X=[1, MKT-RF]. 4) OLS per asset. 5) t from Var=s2(X'X)^-1, df n-2. 6) alpha_ann=a*12 or *252 linear. 7) check residual mean ~0.
formulas: R_i - RF = a + b (Rm - RF) + e
pitfalls: regressing raw returns when RF is given

title: Fama-French three-factor regression per asset
deliverables: per asset table: alpha, b_mkt, s, h, t-stats, R2, adjR2
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], factors [T x 3] MKT-RF, SMB, HML and RF (Ken French percent). DITANYAKAN: loadings, alpha (annualised), t-stats, R2, adjusted R2. RUMUS: Core 1 with k=3: df n-4; adjR2=1-(1-R2)(n-1)/(n-k-1). JAWAB: 1) inner-join dates. 2) factor /100 if percent. 3) excess returns. 4) X=[1,MKT,SMB,HML]. 5) OLS; t-stats, p from t(n-4). 6) annualise alpha. 7) check adjR2<=R2.
formulas: R - RF = a + b MKT + s SMB + h HML + e
pitfalls: factor file in percent mixed with decimal returns

title: Fama-French five-factor regression
deliverables: per asset: alpha, 5 loadings, t-stats, R2
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], factors MKT-RF, SMB, HML, RMW, CMA, RF. DITANYAKAN: five-factor alpha and loadings; compare alpha with FF3 if asked. RUMUS: Core 1 k=5, df n-6. JAWAB: 1) align. 2) excess. 3) X with 5 factors plus ones. 4) OLS. 5) t-stats. 6) comparison table FF3 vs FF5 alpha per asset.
formulas: R - RF = a + b MKT + s SMB + h HML + r RMW + c CMA + e

title: Carhart four-factor regression with momentum
frame: DIKETAHUI: fund returns [T x N], MKT-RF, SMB, HML, UMD/MOM, RF. DITANYAKAN: four-factor alpha, loadings, t-stats. RUMUS: Core 1 k=4, df n-5. JAWAB: 1) merge momentum file (separate Ken French file, same units). 2) excess returns. 3) OLS. 4) annualise alpha. 5) report.
formulas: R - RF = a + b MKT + s SMB + h HML + m UMD + e

title: Newey-West HAC t-statistics for regression coefficients
deliverables: per coefficient: estimate, OLS se, NW se, NW t
frame: DIKETAHUI: y [T], X [T x K] (prepend ones), lag L (given or rule). DITANYAKAN: HAC covariance, NW t-stats for alpha and betas. RUMUS: Core 2: S=sum e^2 x x' + sum_l w_l sum_t e_t e_{t-l}(x_t x_{t-l}'+x_{t-l}x_t'), w_l=1-l/(L+1); V=(X'X)^-1 S (X'X)^-1; toolkit ols(..., hac_lags=L). JAWAB: 1) OLS b, residuals. 2) L per text or Core 4. 3) S raw sums (no 1/n). 4) V sandwich. 5) t=b/sqrt(diag V). 6) compare with statsmodels cov_type HAC use_correction per text.
pitfalls: Bartlett 1-l/L; dividing HAC sums by n

title: Newey-West t-stat of a mean return series
deliverables: summary: mean, NW t, lag used
frame: DIKETAHUI: return series g [T] (spread or slope), lag L. DITANYAKAN: mean, NW standard error, t. RUMUS: Core 3: gamma_l=(1/T) sum u_t u_{t-l}; S=gamma_0+2 sum w_l gamma_l; t=mean/sqrt(S/T); toolkit newey_west_tstat(series, lags). JAWAB: 1) drop NaN. 2) u=g-mean. 3) autocovariances 1/T. 4) S. 5) t. 6) note statsmodels OLS-on-constant gives different small-sample number.

title: Choosing the Newey-West lag
deliverables: summary: L and resulting t under each rule
frame: DIKETAHUI: sample length T; text may state lag or rule. DITANYAKAN: integer lag and t-stats under the selected rule. RUMUS: Core 4: L=floor(4(T/100)^(2/9)) float exponent; alt floor(T^(1/4)); stated lag wins. JAWAB: 1) read text for lag. 2) compute with float 2/9. 3) report L. 4) recompute NW t.
pitfalls: integer division 2/9 = 0

title: Fama-MacBeth two-pass risk-premium estimation
frame: DIKETAHUI: test-asset excess returns [T x N], factors [T x K]. DITANYAKAN: betas, per-period CS slopes, premia with FM t-stats. RUMUS: Core 5: pass 1 TS OLS per asset; pass 2 per t: r_t on [1, beta]; lambda=mean; se=std(ddof=1)/sqrt(T). JAWAB: 1) TS betas (full sample or rolling per text). 2) per date CS OLS. 3) average slopes. 4) se, t. 5) report intercept as pricing error.
pitfalls: pooled panel OLS instead of per-date CS regressions

title: Fama-MacBeth characteristic regressions with NW standard errors
deliverables: summary: mean slope, NW t, avg R2, avg N
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel (date, id, ret_lead1m, characteristics), minimum n per date, lag L. DITANYAKAN: time-series means of CS slopes, FM and NW t-stats. RUMUS: Core 5 with z_t at t and return t->t+1; Core 3 NW for slope series (card V6). JAWAB: 1) per date drop NaN in target and all regressors of THAT model. 2) skip if n<min. 3) winsorise/standardise per text. 4) CS OLS. 5) slope series -> mean, se plain and NW. 6) report.
pitfalls: using current-month return as a regressor (look-ahead)

title: GRS test of joint alpha zero
frame: DIKETAHUI: test-asset excess returns [T x N], factors [T x K]. DITANYAKAN: GRS F statistic and p-value. RUMUS: Core 6: GRS=((T-N-K)/N) a'Sig^-1 a/(1+mu'Om^-1 mu), Sig=E'E/T, Om=(F-mu)'(F-mu)/T; F(N,T-N-K), p=f.sf. JAWAB: 1) TS regressions -> a [N], residuals E [T x N]. 2) Sig MLE. 3) mu factor means, Om MLE demeaned. 4) GRS. 5) p=scipy.stats.f.sf(GRS,N,T-N-K).
formulas: GRS = ((T - N - K)/N) a'Sig^-1 a / (1 + mu'Om^-1 mu)
pitfalls: T-1 covariances; factor covariance not demeaned

title: Variance inflation factors among regressors
frame: DIKETAHUI: regressor matrix [T x K] (factors or characteristics). DITANYAKAN: VIF_j for each regressor. RUMUS: Core 7: VIF_j=1/(1-R2_j) from regression of x_j on other x with intercept. JAWAB: 1) for each j regress on rest with constant. 2) R2_j. 3) VIF. 4) check VIF>=1; equals diag of inverse correlation matrix.
formulas: VIF = diag(C^-1), C correlation of regressors

title: Regression residual diagnostics (Durbin-Watson, R2 checks)
deliverables: per asset: DW, residual std, R2, adjR2
frame: DIKETAHUI: regression outputs or y, X. DITANYAKAN: DW statistic, residual std, fit stats. RUMUS: Core 7: DW=sum(diff e)^2/sum e^2 in [0,4]. JAWAB: 1) residuals. 2) DW. 3) residual std sqrt(SSR/(n-k-1)). 4) check 0<=R2<=1, residuals orthogonal to X.

title: Information ratio, Treynor and appraisal ratio from factor regression
frame: DIKETAHUI: regression alpha, residuals, beta_mkt, excess returns, P. DITANYAKAN: IR=alpha_ann/(std(e,ddof=1) sqrt(P)), Treynor=ann excess/beta. RUMUS: Core 7. JAWAB: 1) alpha_ann=a P. 2) residual vol annualised. 3) IR. 4) Treynor. 5) Sharpe for comparison.

title: Rolling-window beta estimation
deliverables: beta per window end [T-W+1] per asset
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], market [T], window W, min obs. DITANYAKAN: rolling betas labelled at window end date. RUMUS: beta=cov(r,m)/var(m) in each window (same ddof both); equals OLS slope. JAWAB: 1) excess returns per text. 2) windows rows t-W+1..t. 3) skip if valid <min. 4) beta. 5) label end date; n-W+1 windows.
pitfalls: labelling by window start

title: Factor return summary: units, annualised premia and Sharpe
deliverables: per factor: mean, vol, Sharpe, t (annualised)
frame: DIKETAHUI: factor file [T x K] (percent or decimal), frequency. DITANYAKAN: annual mean, vol, Sharpe, t-stat of mean. RUMUS: Card conventions: percent /100; mean x12/x252, Sharpe sqrt(12)/sqrt(252); t=mean/(std/sqrt T). JAWAB: 1) detect units from text/magnitude. 2) decimal. 3) stats. 4) correlation. 5) output percent if asked.
pitfalls: treating 0.5 as 50 percent

title: Single-sort quintile portfolios, equal weighted
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel (date, id, signal, ret_lead1m), Q. DITANYAKAN: per date bucket membership and EW next-period returns. RUMUS: Core 8: sort (signal asc, id asc), 0-based r, q=min(Q, floor(Q r/n)+1). JAWAB: 1) per date drop NaN signal/return. 2) stable rank with id tiebreak. 3) bucket. 4) EW mean of lead return. 5) average over dates. 6) check bucket sizes differ <=1, Q1 lowest.
pitfalls: pandas rank(method=average) or string ids breaking ties

title: Decile sort with value weights by lagged market cap
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with signal, ret_lead1m, market cap ME (t-1 or t). DITANYAKAN: VW decile returns. RUMUS: w_i=ME_{i,t}/sum ME within decile (ME known at formation). JAWAB: 1) breakpoints per date (percentiles or rank rule). 2) assign. 3) weights from lagged ME. 4) VW returns. 5) spread.
formulas: r_d = sum_{i in d} ME_i r_i / sum ME_i
pitfalls: using end-of-holding-period ME

title: NYSE breakpoints for size and value sorts
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with exchange code, ME, B/M. DITANYAKAN: breakpoints from NYSE stocks applied to all stocks. RUMUS: Card V4: NYSE median for size, 30/70 pct for B/M; no exchange field -> all-stock breakpoints. JAWAB: 1) subset NYSE per date. 2) np.percentile linear. 3) assign all stocks with <= / > conventions per text. 4) counts (small buckets may be large).
formulas: BM cuts = pct30, pct70 of NYSE B/M

title: Independent 2x3 double sort building SMB and HML
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with ME, B/M, returns, exchange (breakpoints rule). DITANYAKAN: six VW portfolios and factor returns. RUMUS: Core 8 independent: breakpoints for each var on the full (or NYSE) cross-section, intersect; SMB=1/3(S/L+S/M+S/H)-1/3(B/L+B/M+B/H), HML=1/2(S/H+B/H)-1/2(S/L+B/L). JAWAB: 1) formation date (June, accounting t-1 per text). 2) size and BM bins independently. 3) intersect. 4) VW returns. 5) factors.

title: Dependent (conditional) double sort
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with control var1, signal var2, returns. DITANYAKAN: var2 spread within var1 buckets and averaged across them. RUMUS: Core 8 dependent: bucket on var1, re-sort each bucket on var2 with its own n. JAWAB: 1) per date bucket var1. 2) inside each, rank var2 with own n. 3) cell returns. 4) average high-low var2 across var1 buckets. 5) t-stat over time.
formulas: q2 within q1 uses n_q1 names
pitfalls: using full cross-section breakpoints for var2 (that is independent)

title: Long-short spread portfolio statistics
deliverables: summary: mean, t (OLS and NW), Sharpe, alpha
frame: DIKETAHUI: bucket returns [T x Q]. DITANYAKAN: spread=top-bottom, mean, t, annual Sharpe, CAPM/FF alpha of spread. RUMUS: Core 3 NW t; Core 1 alpha regression. JAWAB: 1) spread. 2) mean, plain t. 3) NW t. 4) Sharpe sqrt(12). 5) regress on factors for alpha. 6) report.

title: Monotonicity across sorted buckets
deliverables: table per bucket: mean, t, count
frame: DIKETAHUI: bucket returns [T x Q]. DITANYAKAN: whether means increase across buckets; count of violations; adjacent differences. RUMUS: Differences d_q=r_{q+1}-r_q; monotone if all d_q mean>0. JAWAB: 1) mean per bucket. 2) adjacent differences series. 3) mean and t per difference. 4) min t. 5) report.

title: 12-1 momentum signal construction
frame: DIKETAHUI: monthly returns panel [T x N], lookback 12, skip 1. DITANYAKAN: momentum signal at each month end. RUMUS: Card V5: compound t-12..t-2; toolkit momentum_signal(returns, lookback, skip, method='compound'). JAWAB: 1) pivot to wide sorted by date. 2) shift by skip. 3) rolling product of (1+r) over 11 months minus 1. 4) require min periods per text. 5) back to long.
pitfalls: including month t-1 or month t (look-ahead)

title: Residual momentum signal
frame: DIKETAHUI: monthly excess returns, FF3 factors, window 36. DITANYAKAN: sum of residuals t-12..t-2 divided by residual std of window. RUMUS: Core 11 (Blitz-Huij-Martens). JAWAB: 1) per stock rolling 36m FF3 OLS ending t-1 (per text). 2) residuals of window. 3) sum months t-12..t-2. 4) divide by std of window residuals. 5) require full window.

title: Cross-sectional winsorise and z-score
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel of raw signal, limits (1/99 pct), ddof. DITANYAKAN: winsorised then z-scored values per date. RUMUS: Card: clip at np.percentile linear per date on eligible universe; z=(x-mean)/std ddof=0; std 0 -> 0. JAWAB: 1) per date eligible names. 2) lo, hi percentiles. 3) clip. 4) mean, std ddof=0. 5) z. 6) check mean 0, std 1.
pitfalls: winsorising after z-scoring; ddof=1 when population stated

title: Composite multi-signal score
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with several signals, sign directions, combination rule. DITANYAKAN: composite per name, then sorted portfolios. RUMUS: z-score each signal (with sign) then average available z (or rank-average). JAWAB: 1) align directions (negate where low is good). 2) winsorise/z per date. 3) average over non-missing signals (min count per text). 4) re-standardise if asked. 5) sort.

title: Industry-neutral signal (demean within sector)
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with signal and industry code. DITANYAKAN: signal demeaned (or z-scored) within date x industry. RUMUS: z_ig=(x-mean_g)/std_g; singleton group -> 0. JAWAB: 1) group by date, industry. 2) demean/standardise. 3) handle size-1 groups. 4) check group means 0.

title: Residualise a signal on size and other characteristics
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with signal and controls (log ME, beta, industry dummies). DITANYAKAN: per date residuals of signal on controls. RUMUS: Per date OLS x=c+Z g+u; signal=u (winsorise first per card). JAWAB: 1) winsorise inputs. 2) per date OLS with constant. 3) residuals. 4) z-score if asked. 5) check residual uncorrelated with controls.

title: Information coefficient: per-date Spearman and ICIR
deliverables: summary: mean IC, std, ICIR, t, hit rate
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel signal at t, forward return t->t+1. DITANYAKAN: rank IC per date and aggregates. RUMUS: toolkit spearman_ic(signal, forward_return); Spearman = Pearson on average ranks. JAWAB: 1) per date drop NaN pairs. 2) IC (empty if constant). 3) mean, std ddof=1. 4) ICIR=mean/std (annualise sqrt(12) if asked). 5) t=mean/(std/sqrt T).
pitfalls: joining signal with same-period return

title: IC decay across forecast horizons
deliverables: table per horizon h: mean IC, t
frame: DIKETAHUI: signal panel, returns panel, horizons list. DITANYAKAN: mean IC for return t+h (or cumulative t->t+h). RUMUS: IC_h=corr_rank(s_t, r_{t+h}). JAWAB: 1) build lead returns by shifting per id. 2) per h IC series. 3) mean, t (NW when overlapping cumulative returns). 4) table.

title: Beta-neutral long-short weights by projection
frame: DIKETAHUI: selected names with raw weights w (e.g. signal) and beta [n]. DITANYAKAN: neutral weights with sum w=0, beta'w=0, sum|w|=1. RUMUS: Core 9: w - X(X'X)^+ X'w, X=[1,beta]; scale sum|w|=1. JAWAB: 1) X. 2) projection via pinv. 3) scale. 4) exposure with SAME beta vector (~1e-16). 5) report.
formulas: w_n = w - X (X'X)^+ X'w, X = [1, beta]
pitfalls: neutralising with winsorised beta but reporting exposure with raw

title: Dollar-neutral rank-weighted long-short book
frame: DIKETAHUI: signal panel, rule (rank-demean or top/bottom quantile EW). DITANYAKAN: weights summing 0 with gross 1, next period returns. RUMUS: w=rank-mean(rank), scale to sum|w|=1; or +1/n_L, -1/n_S on extremes scaled. JAWAB: 1) per date rank. 2) weights. 3) scale. 4) return sum w r_{t+1} (missing lead -> 0 if stated). 5) check sum w=0.

title: Minimum-norm hedge to neutralise factor exposures
frame: DIKETAHUI: current weights w [n], exposure matrix V [K x n]. DITANYAKAN: h minimising ||h||^2 s.t. V(w+h)=0, 1'h=0. RUMUS: Core 10: A=[V;1'], b=[-Vw;0], h=A'(AA')^-1 b (lstsq). JAWAB: 1) stack A. 2) b. 3) np.linalg.lstsq(A, b) min-norm. 4) check A(h)=b.

title: Turnover and transaction costs of a monthly factor portfolio
deliverables: per month: turnover, cost, gross, net
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights per (date, id) each month, returns, cost bps. DITANYAKAN: turnover series and net returns. RUMUS: Card: one-way=0.5 sum|dw| over union of names; cost=bps x sum|dw| usually; read which. JAWAB: 1) align consecutive books on union (missing=0). 2) drift previous book if text says. 3) turnover. 4) first book vs zero book per text. 5) net=gross-cost. 6) empty month: keep last emitted book.

title: Factor-mimicking portfolios from Fama-MacBeth slopes
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel of standardised characteristics and next returns. DITANYAKAN: per date slopes interpreted as returns of portfolios (X'X)^-1 X' rows. RUMUS: Core 5: g_t=(X'X)^-1 X'r; weight matrix W=(X'X)^-1 X'. JAWAB: 1) per date X with ones. 2) W rows. 3) slopes = W r. 4) check row k of W has unit exposure to char k and zero to others. 5) series stats.

title: PCA statistical factors from a return panel
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], K, demean/standardise rule, sign rule. DITANYAKAN: eigen loadings, factor returns, explained variance shares. RUMUS: Card: eigen of covariance (or correlation); sign per stated rule (mean>=0, svd_flip). JAWAB: 1) demean columns. 2) eigh or SVD. 3) sort descending. 4) loadings unit norm. 5) scores = X V. 6) sign normalise. 7) check orthogonal, ratios descending sum<=1.
pitfalls: arbitrary eigenvector signs

title: PCA factor regression and out-of-sample R2
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns [T x N], K components, train/test split. DITANYAKAN: R2 of returns on first K PCs (in and out of sample). RUMUS: R2_total=1-sum e^2/sum r^2 (state demeaned or not); sign-invariant. JAWAB: 1) fit PCA on train. 2) project test returns. 3) residuals. 4) R2 per asset and total. 5) report.

title: IPCA instrumented PCA by alternating least squares
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel returns r_{i,t+1}, characteristics z_{i,t} [N_t x L], K, tolerance. DITANYAKAN: Gamma, f_t, total and predictive R2. RUMUS: Core 12 ALS with per-sweep identification. JAWAB: 1) init Gamma from SVD of managed portfolios Z'r. 2) f_t=(G'Z'ZG)^-1 G'Z'r. 3) vec(G) solve. 4) normalise G'G=I, F'F/T diag desc, sign mean f>=0. 5) iterate. 6) R2 total, predictive with mean f.
formulas: sum_t (Z'Z kron f f') vec(G) = sum_t vec(Z'r f')
pitfalls: no per-sweep normalisation

title: Expanding-window out-of-sample return prediction
deliverables: summary: OOS R2 vs historical mean
frame: DIKETAHUI: predictor series x_t and target r_{t+1} (or panel), start index. DITANYAKAN: predictions using data strictly before t, OOS R2. RUMUS: Card: coefficients from months strictly before t; append t after predicting; R2_OOS=1-sum(r-rhat)^2/sum(r-rbar)^2. JAWAB: 1) loop t from start. 2) fit on past. 3) predict. 4) benchmark expanding mean. 5) R2_OOS.

title: Betting-against-beta factor construction
frame: DIKETAHUI: returns, market, rolling windows for vol and correlation. DITANYAKAN: shrunk betas, rank-weighted low/high legs levered to beta 1. RUMUS: beta_ts=rho sigma_i/sigma_m; shrink 0.6 beta+0.4; BAB=(r_L-rf)/beta_L-(r_H-rf)/beta_H. JAWAB: 1) betas. 2) ranks centred, weights split into long low-beta and short high-beta, each summing 1. 3) leg betas. 4) BAB. 5) stats.

title: Return decomposition into factor contributions
deliverables: per asset: alpha, contribution per factor
frame: DIKETAHUI: regression loadings b [K], factor means [K], asset mean excess return. DITANYAKAN: mean excess = alpha + sum b_k mean F_k. RUMUS: OLS identity: mean(y)=a+b'mean(F) exactly with intercept. JAWAB: 1) loadings. 2) contributions b_k mean F_k. 3) annualise. 4) check sum equals mean excess.
formulas: mean(R - RF) = a + sum_k b_k mean(F_k)

title: Portfolio factor exposures and risk from a factor model
deliverables: summary: total, factor, specific vol; per factor contribution
frame: DIKETAHUI: weights [N], loadings B [N x K], factor cov F [K x K], specific variances D [N]. DITANYAKAN: portfolio exposures B'w, variances. RUMUS: Sigma=B F B'+D; var_sys=(B'w)'F(B'w), var_spec=w'Dw. JAWAB: 1) exposures x=B'w. 2) var_sys. 3) var_spec. 4) total. 5) per factor contribution x_k(Fx)_k. 6) annualise.
formulas: var_p = x'F x + w'D w, x = B'w

title: Spanning regression of a new factor on existing factors
frame: DIKETAHUI: new factor [T], existing factors [T x K]. DITANYAKAN: alpha of new factor; significant -> not spanned. RUMUS: Core 1/2: f_new=a+b'F+e. JAWAB: 1) align. 2) OLS. 3) NW t for alpha. 4) annualise. 5) report spanned or not by alpha t.

title: Pricing errors of test portfolios: mean absolute alpha
deliverables: summary: A|a|, GRS, average R2 per model
frame: DIKETAHUI: test portfolio excess returns [T x N], several factor models. DITANYAKAN: per model mean|alpha|, GRS, avg R2. RUMUS: Core 1 per portfolio; Core 6 GRS. JAWAB: 1) for each model regress all portfolios. 2) mean |a|, ratio A|a|/A|rbar - mean rbar| per text. 3) GRS. 4) table.

title: Shanken errors-in-variables correction
deliverables: summary: lambda, FM se, Shanken se
frame: DIKETAHUI: Fama-MacBeth outputs: lambda [K], slope series, factor covariance Sigma_f. DITANYAKAN: Shanken-corrected se. RUMUS: Var_sh=(1+lambda'Sigma_f^-1 lambda) Var_FM + Sigma_f/T (for factor slopes). JAWAB: 1) FM var of mean slope. 2) c=lambda'Sigma_f^-1 lambda (per period units). 3) corrected var. 4) t.

title: Subperiod stability of factor premia
frame: DIKETAHUI: factor or spread series [T], split dates. DITANYAKAN: mean, t in each subperiod; difference test. RUMUS: Welch t for difference of means or regression on dummy. JAWAB: 1) split by dates inclusive rules. 2) stats per part. 3) difference t. 4) table.

title: Panel alignment: signal at t with next-period return
frame: DIKETAHUI: long panel (date, id, ret, signal), possible gaps. DITANYAKAN: for each (date, id) the return of the next period. RUMUS: Card: signal at t, return t->t+1; shift within id on sorted dates; gaps -> NaN, not the next available. JAWAB: 1) sort by id, date; unique (date, id); ints for ids. 2) groupby id shift(-1). 3) verify the next date is the next calendar month. 4) drop last.
pitfalls: shifting across missing months

title: Deterministic bucket assignment with ties and small cross-sections
frame: DIKETAHUI: per date n names, signal with ties, Q. DITANYAKAN: bucket labels by the rank rule. RUMUS: Core 8: np.lexsort((ids, sig)), q=min(Q, floor(Q r/n)+1); small n leaves empty top buckets - skip, do not force. JAWAB: 1) integer ids. 2) lexsort. 3) bucket. 4) counts differ <=1. 5) skip dates with n<Q if stated.
pitfalls: string id order ('10' < '9')

title: Value-weighted versus equal-weighted factor returns
frame: DIKETAHUI: panel with ME (lagged), signal buckets, returns. DITANYAKAN: spread under both weights. RUMUS: VW weights ME_{t}/sum ME; EW 1/n. JAWAB: 1) buckets. 2) both weights. 3) spreads. 4) means, t, correlation.
formulas: r_VW = sum ME r / sum ME

title: Market beta of a long-short factor portfolio and hedging
frame: DIKETAHUI: spread returns [T], market excess [T]. DITANYAKAN: beta, hedged series r - beta m, alpha. RUMUS: Core 1. JAWAB: 1) OLS. 2) hedged = r - b m (in-sample or rolling per text). 3) stats. 4) check hedged beta ~0 in sample.

title: Characteristic panel cleaning before sorts
frame: DIKETAHUI: raw panel with returns, price, share code, exchange. DITANYAKAN: eligible universe per date. RUMUS: Filters per text (price>=5, share code 10/11, non-missing ME); percent returns -> decimal. JAWAB: 1) dedupe (date, id). 2) cast ids int, dates month-end. 3) filters. 4) counts. 5) check no duplicates.

title: Rolling-window factor regression for time-varying alpha
deliverables: alpha and betas per window end [T-W+1]
